title: Video desk, Wed Nov 18 set: Where The Money Went (Nvidia's quarter), Trading Explained (P/E ratio with the Mag 7), Inside The AI Studio (how a coloring book gets made)

general-counsel-agent.note: All ten checks on file after reviewing the three 9:16 review sheets (after the fixes), report.json spoken text, titles, captions and sources. Defamation screen: the Nvidia figures are its own reported results as listed by Webull; the P/E figures are Webull snapshot data with the formula shown; the studio video uses only the studio's own book records; no person is named. Nothing commits the owner; delivery is to the owner only. AI review, not legal advice.

advertising-consumer-protection-counsel.note: Every number traces to a saved raw response or a repo record (factcheck.py: 0 unmatched). Nvidia: raw/get_income_statement_0.json (quarter ended Oct 25, 2026, published Nov 17); per-$100 bars are rounded to the cent and labeled as rounded (they sum to $99.99); year-over-year changes use the quarter ended Oct 26, 2025. P/E: raw/get_stock_snapshot_0.json, each P/E re-derived as price / trailing-12-month EPS; the definition is attributed to Charles Schwab and Nasdaq. Studio: '10 coloring books in 10 weekdays' = book-kit/records Nov 5 to Nov 18 (10 records, each delivered and approved); '30 drawings, 22 helpers and 8 things they use', '8 fixes', '64 pages', 'a My First Community Helpers book already exists' and 'the agents don't publish, set prices or buy ads' all come from today's record. The video says the books were made and delivered, not sold or published.

email-anti-spam-compliance-counsel.note: No commercial email. The delivery email goes to the owner only.

privacy-data-protection-counsel.note: No personal data. No person is named or shown; the owner isn't named or shown, and the book's pen name is left out.

copyright-fair-use-counsel.note: Visuals are drawn from data and text by the kit's renderer; the voice is Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0); music is synthesized per video by music.py; fonts are Inter, Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono (SIL OFL). The P/E definition is paraphrased with credit, not quoted. The studio video shows no book pages; the book's own art is original code-drawn work. No screenshots, logos or third-party footage.

trademark-brand-clearance-counsel.note: Nvidia, Tesla, Alphabet, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Charles Schwab, Nasdaq and Webull are named only to refer to them (nominative use); no logos; nothing suggests endorsement or affiliation. 'Mag 7' is a descriptive market nickname, used as in earlier runs. 'My First Community Helpers' is named only as an existing title the studio avoided, without its publisher. 'My First Helpers Coloring Book' has a web screen only (not a clearance), as recorded by the book desk; the owner decides before publishing it.

financial-content-compliance-counsel.note: 'Educational only. Not financial advice.' is on screen in the Nvidia and P/E outros and in both captions. No buy/sell call, target, prediction or performance promise. The P/E video explains the formula and its limits (backward-looking, one-time items, forward P/E uses estimates) and never calls a stock cheap, expensive or a better value. The Nvidia video reports results only; it doesn't mention today's share move or give a reason for any move. The studio video isn't financial content and makes no earnings claim.

platform-terms-policy-counsel.note: Original content, no reposted clips, no engagement bait beyond 'Follow for more' and the quiz prompt. The narrator is a synthetic voice: turn on Instagram/Facebook's 'AI info' label when posting (in posting notes). The studio video and its caption also say 'Made with AI'. Nothing is posted by the desk.

kids-content-coppa-counsel.note: The studio video is about making children's coloring books, but it is a behind-the-scenes piece for adults (no characters, games or child-directed calls to action) and collects nothing; post it as general audience, not 'made for kids'. The other two are general-audience finance education. No data collected.

contracts-commercial-terms-counsel.note: No sponsors, affiliate links or paid placements. Webull market data is used for the owner's own educational videos, as in prior runs; no redistribution of raw feeds. The studio video makes no promise about when or where the books will be sold. Outros make no schedule promises beyond 'Follow for'.
